decision.explanation: Document d00 confirms Shae Jones released an album titled 'Talk Show' in 1999, while document d03 confirms The Go-Go's released an album with the same title in 1984; these are distinct referents. Document d02 claiming Beyoncé released an album named 'Talk Show' is internally inconsistent with real-world facts (Beyoncé's debut was 'Dangerously in Love') and contradicts the specific details in d00 regarding the artist's name, suggesting a hallucinated or erroneous text generation rather than a valid alternative referent. The fallible prior citing John Prine is rejected as no document supports this claim.
